title: Battle of Weihaiwei
text: The Battle of Weihaiwei (Japanese: Ikaiei-no-tatakai  took place between 20 January and 12 February 1895, during the First Sino-Japanese War in Weihai, Shandong Province, China, between the forces of Japan and Qing China. In early January 1895, the Japanese landed forces in eastern Shandong, positioning them behind the Chinese naval base at Weihaiwei.
